name: bengkelgo
description: Azure App Service entry point: one Node web app serving the React build and the Express API (see docs/deploy-azure-appservice.md)

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.postbuild: node -e "if (process.env.CI) { require('child_process').execSync('npm prune --omit=dev --prefix backend', { stdio: 'inherit' }); require('fs').rmSync('frontend/node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true }); }"
